# Columns of the `m.partners` datasets

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Each section lists one dataset's columns in the order every verb returns them. **Supplied by** names the transports that fill a column; a column the serving transport does not fill is null. The wire-field columns name the Massive fields behind each column (`request` for a value the library fills from the request). The same descriptions appear in the web UI's column tooltips and in a query's `columns()`.

<a id="benzinga-analysts"></a>

## `m.partners.benzinga.analysts`

Benzinga's profiles of sell-side analysts, with each analyst's firm and track record.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The unique identifier assigned by Benzinga to the research firm or investment bank. | REST | `benzinga_firm_id` |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. | REST | `benzinga_id` |
| `FirmName` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the ratings. | REST | `firm_name` |
| `FullName` | String | The full name of the analyst associated with the ratings. | REST | `full_name` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the analyst record was last updated in the system. | REST | `last_updated` |
| `OverallAvgReturn` | double | The average percent price difference per rating since the date of recommendation. | REST | `overall_avg_return` |
| `OverallAvgReturnPercentile` | double | The analyst's percentile rank based on average return, relative to other analysts. | REST | `overall_avg_return_percentile` |
| `OverallSuccessRate` | double | The percentage of gain/loss ratings that resulted in a gain overall. | REST | `overall_success_rate` |
| `SmartScore` | double | A weighted average of the total_ratings_percentile, overall_avg_return_percentile, and overall_success_rate. | REST | `smart_score` |
| `TotalRatings` | double | The total number of ratings issued by the analyst included in the performance calculation. | REST | `total_ratings` |
| `TotalRatingsPercentile` | double | The analyst's percentile rank based on the total number of ratings issued, relative to other analysts. | REST | `total_ratings_percentile` |

## `m.partners.benzinga.analyst_insights`

Benzinga analyst insights on US stocks: a rating, a price target, and the reason.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company being rated." | REST | `ticker` |
| `BenzingaFirmId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for the firm record. | REST | `benzinga_firm_id` |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. | REST | `benzinga_id` |
| `BenzingaRatingId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for the rating record. | REST | `benzinga_rating_id` |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company being rated. | REST | `company_name` |
| `Date` | LocalDate | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the rating was issued. | REST | `date` |
| `Firm` | String | The name of the research firm or investment bank issuing the rating. | REST | `firm` |
| `Insight` | String | Narrative commentary or reasoning provided by the analyst or firm to explain the rating or price target. | REST | `insight` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the rating was last updated in the system. | REST | `last_updated` |
| `PriceTarget` | double | The current price target set by the analyst. | REST | `price_target` |
| `Rating` | String | The current rating set by the analyst. | REST | `rating` |
| `RatingAction` | String | The description of the change in rating from the firm's last rating. Possible values include: downgrades, maintains, reinstates, reiterates, upgrades, assumes, initiates_coverage_on, terminates_coverage_on, removes, suspends, firm_dissolved. | REST | `rating_action` |

## `m.partners.benzinga.consensus_ratings`

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |

| `HighPriceTarget` | double | The highest price target among all contributing analysts. | REST | `high_price_target` |
| `HoldRatings` | long | The count of 'Hold' ratings from contributing analysts. | REST | `hold_ratings` |
| `LowPriceTarget` | double | The lowest price target among all contributing analysts. | REST | `low_price_target` |
| `PriceTargetContributors` | long | The number of unique analysts contributing price targets. | REST | `price_target_contributors` |
| `RatingsContributors` | long | The number of unique analysts contributing to the overall ratings consensus. | REST | `ratings_contributors` |
| `SellRatings` | long | The count of 'Sell' ratings from contributing analysts. | REST | `sell_ratings` |
| `StrongBuyRatings` | long | The count of 'Strong Buy' ratings from contributing analysts. | REST | `strong_buy_ratings` |
| `StrongSellRatings` | long | The count of 'Strong Sell' ratings from contributing analysts. | REST | `strong_sell_ratings` |
| `Ticker` | String | The requested ticker. | REST | `ticker` |

<a id="benzinga-guidance"></a>

## `m.partners.benzinga.guidance`

Earnings and revenue guidance issued by US companies, as reported by Benzinga.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company issuing guidance." | REST | `ticker` |
| `BenzingaId` | String | A unique identifier assigned by Benzinga to the guidance record. | REST | `benzinga_id` |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company issuing guidance. | REST | `company_name` |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 code representing the currency in which the company issued its guidance figures. | REST | `currency` |
| `Date` | LocalDate | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the guidance was issued. | REST | `date` |
| `EpsMethod` | String | The methodology of the EPS figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), ffo (Funds From Operations, a non-GAAP metric commonly used to assess the operating performance of REITs), and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). | REST | `eps_method` |
| `EstimatedEpsGuidance` | double | The analyst consensus EPS estimate at the time the company issued its guidance. This can sit above, below, or in line with the company's issued range. | REST | `estimated_eps_guidance` |
| `EstimatedRevenueGuidance` | double | The analyst consensus revenue estimate at the time the company issued its guidance. This can sit above, below, or in line with the company's issued range. | REST | `estimated_revenue_guidance` |
| `FiscalPeriod` | String | The fiscal quarter to which the guidance applies, such as Q1, Q2, Q3, or Q4. | REST | `fiscal_period` |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year corresponding to the period for which the guidance is issued. | REST | `fiscal_year` |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). | REST | `importance` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the record was last updated in the system. | REST | `last_updated` |
| `MaxEpsGuidance` | double | The highest EPS value the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST | `max_eps_guidance` |
| `MaxRevenueGuidance` | double | The highest revenue figure the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST | `max_revenue_guidance` |
| `MinEpsGuidance` | double | The lowest EPS value the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST | `min_eps_guidance` |
| `MinRevenueGuidance` | double | The lowest revenue figure the company expects for the fiscal period if a range was provided. | REST | `min_revenue_guidance` |
| `Notes` | String | Additional descriptive text or commentary provided about the guidance record. | REST | `notes` |
| `Positioning` | String | Indicates how a particular guidance value is presented relative to other figures disclosed by the company. Possible values are 'primary' (the emphasized figure) and 'secondary' (a supporting or alternate figure) | REST | `positioning` |
| `PreviousMaxEpsGuidance` | double | The highest EPS value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST | `previous_max_eps_guidance` |
| `PreviousMaxRevenueGuidance` | double | The highest revenue value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST | `previous_max_revenue_guidance` |
| `PreviousMinEpsGuidance` | double | The lowest EPS value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST | `previous_min_eps_guidance` |
| `PreviousMinRevenueGuidance` | double | The lowest revenue value issued in a previous guidance record for the same fiscal period. | REST | `previous_min_revenue_guidance` |
| `ReleaseType` | String | Indicates whether the guidance was issued as part of a scheduled earnings release ('official') or as an unscheduled update ('preliminary'). | REST | `release_type` |
| `RevenueMethod` | String | The methodology of the revenue figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). | REST | `revenue_method` |
| `Time` | String | The time of day the guidance was announced, in HH:mm:ss format. | REST | `time` |

<a id="benzinga-earnings"></a>

## `m.partners.benzinga.earnings`

Earnings announcements of US companies from Benzinga, with estimates and surprises.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `ticker`: "The stock symbol of the company reporting earnings." | REST | `ticker` |
| `ActualEps` | double | The actual earnings per share (EPS) reported by the company for the given period. | REST | `actual_eps` |
| `ActualRevenue` | double | The actual revenue reported by the company for the given fiscal period. | REST | `actual_revenue` |
| `BenzingaId` | String | The identifier used by Benzinga for this record. | REST | `benzinga_id` |
| `CompanyName` | String | The name of the company releasing earnings. | REST | `company_name` |
| `Currency` | String | The ISO 4217 currency code indicating the denomination in which the figures are reported. | REST | `currency` |
| `Date` | LocalDate | The calendar date (formatted as YYYY-MM-DD) when the earnings are scheduled or were reported. | REST | `date` |
| `DateStatus` | String | Indicates whether the date of the earnings report has been confirmed. Possible values include: projected, confirmed. | REST | `date_status` |
| `EpsMethod` | String | The methodology of the EPS figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), ffo (Funds From Operations, a non-GAAP metric commonly used to assess the operating performance of REITs), and adj (adjusted, non-GAAP). | REST | `eps_method` |
| `EpsSurprise` | double | The difference between the actual and estimated EPS. | REST | `eps_surprise` |
| `EpsSurprisePercent` | double | The EPS surprise relative to the estimate, as a decimal fraction (0.75 = 75%), calculated as eps_surprise divided by the absolute value of estimated_eps. Positive is a beat and negative a miss, even when the estimate is negative. When the estimate is 0 the value is 1 or -1, and estimates near 0 give very large values. | REST | `eps_surprise_percent` |
| `EstimatedEps` | double | The analyst consensus estimate for earnings per share (EPS) for the given period. | REST | `estimated_eps` |
| `EstimatedRevenue` | double | The analyst consensus estimate for the company's revenue in the given period. | REST | `estimated_revenue` |
| `FiscalPeriod` | String | The fiscal period for which the earnings are reported. Examples include: Q1, Q2, H1, FY. | REST | `fiscal_period` |
| `FiscalYear` | long | The fiscal year in which the earnings period falls. | REST | `fiscal_year` |
| `Importance` | long | A subjective indicator of the importance of the event, on a scale from 0 (lowest) to 5 (highest). | REST | `importance` |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The timestamp (formatted as an ISO 8601 timestamp) when the record was last updated in the system. | REST | `last_updated` |
| `Notes` | String | Additional context, commentary, or clarifying notes related to the earnings event. | REST | `notes` |
| `PreviousEps` | double | The company's reported earnings per share (EPS) for the previous comparable period. | REST | `previous_eps` |
| `PreviousRevenue` | double | The company's revenue for the previous comparable fiscal period. | REST | `previous_revenue` |
| `RevenueMethod` | String | The methodology of the revenue figure. Possible values are gaap (standardized financials under Generally Accepted Accounting Principles), adj (adjusted, non-GAAP figures that exclude certain items like one-time charges or divestitures), and rental (revenue specifically derived from rental operations, typically used by REITs, leasing companies, or businesses with a rental-based model). | REST | `revenue_method` |
| `RevenueSurprise` | double | The difference between the actual and estimated revenue. | REST | `revenue_surprise` |
| `RevenueSurprisePercent` | double | The revenue surprise relative to the estimate, as a decimal fraction (0.126 = 12.6%), calculated as revenue_surprise divided by the absolute value of estimated_revenue. Positive is a beat and negative a miss. | REST | `revenue_surprise_percent` |
| `Time` | String | The time (formatted as 24-hour HH:MM:SS EST) when the earnings are scheduled or were reported. | REST | `time` |

## `m.partners.etf_global.constituents`

The holdings of US-listed ETFs from ETF Global, one row per fund, date, and holding.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `composite_ticker`: "The stock ticker symbol of the ETF that holds these constituent securities." | REST | `composite_ticker` |
| `AssetClass` | String | The broad category of asset type, such as Equity, Corporate Bond, Municipal Bond, etc. | REST | `asset_class` |
| `ConstituentName` | String | The full company or security name of the constituent holding. | REST | `constituent_name` |
| `ConstituentRank` | long | The rank of this constituent within the ETF for a given effective_date, ordered by weight (descending), market_value (descending), and constituent_ticker (ascending). A rank of 1 indicates the largest holding. | REST | `constituent_rank` |
| `ConstituentTicker` | String | The stock ticker symbol of the individual security held within the ETF. | REST | `constituent_ticker` |
| `CountryOfExchange` | String | The country where the exchange that lists this constituent security is located. | REST | `country_of_exchange` |
| `CurrencyTraded` | String | The local currency in which this constituent security is denominated and traded. | REST | `currency_traded` |
| `EffectiveDate` | LocalDate | The date showing when the information was accurate or valid; some issuers, such as Vanguard, release their data on a delay, so the effective_date can be several weeks earlier than the processed_date. | REST | `effective_date` |
| `Exchange` | String | The name of the stock exchange where this constituent security is primarily traded. | REST | `exchange` |
| `Figi` | String | The Financial Instrument Global Identifier, an open standard for uniquely identifying financial instruments. | REST | `figi` |

<a id="fable-merchant_aggregates"></a>

## `m.partners.fable.merchant_aggregates`

Daily European consumer spending per merchant, from Fable Data's transaction panel.

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by | REST field |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Channel` | String | Transaction channel. Possible values: online, offline, bnpl (buy now pay later platforms such as Scala, Klarna, Zilch). | REST | `channel` |
| `ConsumerType` | String | The panel the account is sourced from. Possible values: consumer_credit, consumer_debit, open_banking. | REST | `consumer_type` |
| `EightDayRollingCategoryAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country, consumer type, and that transacted in this merchant category (MCC Group) over the prior 8 days. Used for short-term normalization calculations (e.g., spend per 1000 panelists = (total_spend / eight_day_rolling_category_accounts) * 1000). | REST | `eight_day_rolling_category_accounts` |
| `EightDayRollingTotalAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country and consumer type that had any transaction activity (across all categories) over the prior 8 days. Provides a baseline for total panel size. | REST | `eight_day_rolling_total_accounts` |
| `MccGroup` | String | Merchant category code group associated with the merchant or payment processor. | REST | `mcc_group` |
| `MerchantIndustry` | String | Industry name based on GICS/BICS/ICB data classification for the merchant. | REST | `merchant_industry` |
| `MerchantTicker` | String | Stock ticker associated with the merchant (~250 US public companies mapped). Uses Bloomberg tickers and they are point in time. | REST | `merchant_ticker` |
| `Name` | String | The merchant or entity name for this aggregate (lowercase). When type is 'merchant', this value can be used as the lookup_name in the merchant-hierarchy endpoint to retrieve full corporate hierarchy details. | REST | `name` |
| `ParentName` | String | Merchant's parent business name (Title Case). Useful for aggregating transactions across subsidiary brands. Also available in the merchant-hierarchy endpoint for full corporate structure. | REST | `parent_name` |
| `PublishedDate` | LocalDate | The date when this data version was published. For original data, this is approximately 7 days after transaction_date. | REST | `published_date` |
| `SpendInDistinctAccountKeyCount` | long | The count of distinct account keys (unique consumer accounts) with inbound transactions. | REST | `spend_in_distinct_account_key_count` |
| `SpendInSpend` | double | The total inbound transaction amount (refunds, returns, credits) in the specified currency for this aggregation. Values are positive, representing money flowing back into consumer accounts. | REST | `spend_in_spend` |
| `SpendInTransactionCount` | long | The count of inbound transactions (refunds, returns). | REST | `spend_in_transaction_count` |
| `SpendOutDistinctAccountKeyCount` | long | The count of distinct account keys (unique consumer accounts) with outbound transactions. | REST | `spend_out_distinct_account_key_count` |
| `SpendOutSpend` | double | The total outbound transaction amount (money spent by consumers) in the specified currency for this aggregation. Values are negative, representing money flowing out of consumer accounts. | REST | `spend_out_spend` |
| `SpendOutTransactionCount` | long | The count of outbound transactions (purchases, payments). | REST | `spend_out_transaction_count` |
| `TotalAccounts` | long | The total count of distinct consumer accounts with any transaction activity for this aggregation. | REST | `total_accounts` |
| `TotalSpend` | double | Sum of spend_out_spend and spend_in_spend. Typically negative (net outflow). A positive value indicates refunds exceeded new spending for this aggregation. | REST | `total_spend` |
| `TotalTransactions` | long | The total count of all transactions (outbound + inbound). | REST | `total_transactions` |
| `TransactionCurrency` | String | ISO currency code for the transaction (base card/account currency). Always EUR or GBP in this dataset. All spend amounts are denominated in this currency. | REST | `transaction_currency` |
| `TransactionDate` | LocalDate | The calendar date when the consumer transactions occurred. | REST | `transaction_date` |
| `TwentyEightDayRollingCategoryAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country, consumer type, and that transacted in this merchant category (MCC Group) over the prior 28 days. Used for longer-term normalization calculations. | REST | `twenty_eight_day_rolling_category_accounts` |
| `TwentyEightDayRollingTotalAccounts` | long | The count of unique consumer accounts active for a given country and consumer type that had any transaction activity (across all categories) over the prior 28 days. Provides a longer-term baseline for total panel size. | REST | `twenty_eight_day_rolling_total_accounts` |
| `Type` | String | The type of aggregation. Can be 'merchant' or 'payment_processor'. | REST | `type` |
| `UserCountry` | String | Country of consumer's residence (ISO codes). Available countries: UK, DE, FR, ES, IT, AT. Values outside these are mapped to 'unknown'. | REST | `user_country` |
